minecraft:written_book_content.title: A Letter, Unsent
minecraft:written_book_content.author: E. Vance
pages:
I do not know how to file what just happened, so I am not going to. I am writing it to you instead.

You did not seal him. You remembered him. The readings did not spike—they opened, like a door painted shut for forty years.
He is whole. He is somewhere. He is, for the first time since I was a child, HIM. I should be terrified. UMBRA is terrified. They are already drafting the memos.
Because here is what they will not say aloud: the force that erased him was never confined to this site. It does not live in the Frame. The Frame was a bandage.

You removed the bandage.

Thorne is free, and he remembers everything—including what exists on the other side of forgetting. He knows where the erasure reaches from now. I think he intends to find it.

UMBRA wants to hire you to contain what follows. I want to ask you to help me follow him.

They are not the same job. Choose carefully. I will be in touch.

— Eleanor
